  • 英語名: Bon Bon!! Lamp no Majin ga Kanaetakunai to Iidashita no de

别名

  • Alakazam!! -Because the Genie Didnt Want to Grant My Wish-

あらすじ

I found some old dish for sauce in a box sent from my parents.

I went to clean it off and bwaaaaawwn, a blonde girl popped out.

“I am the genie of the curry mix,” she said.

  • 英語名: Doubly na Kanojo H na Jonan ka Dou ka wa Sateoki

别名

  • Doubly Girlfriend

あらすじ

The protagonist’s life has been nothing but disaster.

The fiascos he encounters are always woman-related.

Indeed, he has “girl problems”.

Every time he meets one it’s another wild ride.

“Here let me take off your pants” = problem

Girl wanking him with her hands = problem
